content.tagline: Dermatology-clinic skincare from Seoul, across five brands
content.descriptor: Korean dermatology-clinic group: AGAFAR skincare, agapharma Meditive Formula 3X, a'reiv masks and sun care, EXOXEN and NADXEN boosters, and the PLAZION in-clinic device
about: AGAFAR is a Korean skincare and dermatology-clinic brand based in Seoul. According to its official website, the company runs its own AGAFAR dermatology clinics in Korea — the site names clinic directors in Gyeyang, Gimpo and Juan — and presented its DERMA MODE PROGRAM catalog under the AGAFAR, agapharma and a'reiv names at K-Beauty Expo Korea 2026.

The portfolio spans five lines: AGAFAR (cleanser, toner, ampoules, eye care, moisturizer and sunblock for daily use), agapharma's Meditive Formula 3X (a hyal-collagen professional line of cleanser, ampoule, skin booster and creams), a'reiv (a laboratory-coded sheet mask and a calming sun cream), EXOXEN (a high-concentration exosome booster) and NADXEN (an NAD⁺/NMN ampoule and serum, according to the company). AGAFAR also shows PLAZION, an in-clinic device its own materials describe as improving product absorption and penetration; Teranova has not seen a technical specification for it.

According to the company, products reach distribution markets including the US, Europe, Turkey and the UAE, and a separate North American affiliate describes a wider clinic network abroad. These are the company's own statements, confirmed for a specific enquiry, not independently verified by Teranova.
facts: Five brands: AGAFAR, agapharma (Meditive Formula 3X), a'reiv, EXOXEN, NADXEN
Runs its own dermatology clinics in Korea, according to the company
20-SKU DERMA MODE PROGRAM catalog: cleansers, toners, ampoules, eye care, creams, sunblock, sheet mask, boosters
PLAZION in-clinic device for product absorption, according to the company
Distribution according to the company: US, Europe, Turkey, UAE
catalog_notes: All-in-one cleansing gel with portulaca and madecassoside that removes makeup and impurities without tightness.
Toner with betaine and chia seed extract that balances skin after cleansing and preps it for the next steps.
Soothing gel with green tea, propolis and licorice root for sensitive, irritated skin; doubles as an overnight mask.
Brightening ampoule with a vitamin A/C/E complex for dull, uneven skin tone.
Firming ampoule with an 8-peptide and collagen complex for mature, dehydrated skin.
PDRN and multi-molecular hyaluronic acid ampoule for deep hydration and radiance.
Soothing, brightening ampoule with a Vita K complex and azulene for sensitive skin.
Eye serum with a red berry complex and collagen for firmness around the eyes.
Daily eye cream with Lactobacillus ferment and peptides for elasticity and firmness.
Barrier-repair spot cream with madecassoside and a ceramide complex for damaged skin.
All-skin-type base cream with ceramide and cholesterol that preps skin for active steps.
Lightweight daily sunblock with a multi-peptide complex and no white cast.
4-free foam cleanser built on the Meditive Formula 3X complex for sensitive and combination skin.
Daily ampoule combining Meditive Formula 3X and 5-free probiotics for barrier and microbiome care.
Single-dose skin booster for use after laser treatments or with in-clinic devices.
Light, non-sticky cream with patented moisturizers for all skin types.
Rich regenerating cream for post-treatment care after laser or peeling.
High-concentration exosome booster for post-procedure and in-clinic skin renewal.
Ultra-fine sheet mask with triple hyaluronic acid for dry, sensitive skin.
Matte-finish sun cream for oily, sensitive skin that doubles as a makeup primer.

lines.name: AGAFAR
lines.note: The flagship daily-care line: Mild Cleansing Gel, Balancing Soothing Toner and Eliderm soothing gel, four Pro Ampoules (Mela brightening, Double firming, PDRN-HA, Vita K), Shine Eye Serum and Star Eye Cream, Oint spot-recovery cream, Moisturizing Cream and a Daily Sunblock SPF50+ PA++++.

lines.name: agapharma
lines.note: Meditive Formula 3X, agapharma's hyal-collagen professional line: a gentle foam cleanser, an active ampoule, a 7-ampoule skin booster, a light cream and a regenerating cream, built around a Hyal-Collagen, Bio Lacto Exo and Super Centella complex.

lines.name: a'reiv
lines.note: A Hyaluronic Ultra-Fine sheet mask (Lab Laboratory Mask) and a Calming Sun Cream SPF50+ PA++++ for oily and sensitive skin.

lines.name: EXOXEN
lines.note: A high-concentration exosome booster (3 ml × 10, Booster), positioned by the company for post-procedure and in-clinic use.

lines.name: NADXEN
lines.note: An NAD⁺ and NMN ampoule and serum pair, shown on AGAFAR's own site as a bestselling line; the company has not sent Teranova a separate ingredient or claim list for it.

tech.name: PLAZION device
tech.note: An in-clinic device shown in the company's marketing material with the claims "Better Absorption" and "Deeper Penetration" and an intensity dial. Teranova has not received a technical specification, model name or registration status for it.

tech.name: Clinical actives
tech.note: The DERMA MODE PROGRAM catalog is built around PDRN, multi-peptide and hyaluronic-acid complexes, exosomes, Centella asiatica, ceramides and ferment-based actives, with volume and key ingredients stated per product in the company's own catalog.

tech.name: Clinic-linked development
tech.note: According to the company, AGAFAR's formulas follow prescriptions and recommendations from its dermatology clinics; Teranova has not independently verified this claim.
